articles.summary:

articles.title: Microsoft Bans Its AI Models From Launching Cyberattacks or Escalating Their Own Access
articles.summary:

The rules also require agents to remain interruptible, transparent, and confined to human-assigned permissions and objectives. articles.title: Google’s New Search Redirects Make It Harder to Check Where Links Lead Before Clicking
articles.summary:
Google is changing how some search-result links behave. Certain results now pass through an encoded Google redirect rather than opening the listed site, making a browser’s link preview less useful as a quick safety check.
